name: lecture-to-course
description: Offline lecture-course templates and browser verification tools

scripts.format: node scripts/dev.cjs prettier --write lecture-to-course/assets/template/*.{js,css,json} scripts/*.cjs tests/*.cjs demo/*.{html,json} package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: node scripts/dev.cjs prettier --check lecture-to-course/assets/template/*.{js,css,json} scripts/*.cjs tests/*.cjs demo/*.{html,json} package.json .prettierrc.json
